r.locality: 32 Kingfisher Rd, Mount Cotton QLD 4165, Australia

r.notes: Koala appeared healthy. It began running across the road in front of me, but stopped as I braked the car. It sat on the road in front of me as I put the car in park and put on my hazard lights. As I grabbed my camera it walked across in front of my car towards the Teesdake Road junction before bounding off towards the trees. Could have been a juvenile or small adult. I wasn’t able to get a photo of it sat very clearly in front of my headlights because I had to secure the car first, by which time it was moving again.
Mother & baby feeding separately in the tree later that night.  :)  Pair also sighted in same garden on 07.02.19 in E. racemosa.
Reported to KAG email.
Haven't heard this once familiar sound in a long time ... delighted to be woken up!
Reported to Koala Action Group via email
first sighting for several years
I have had sightings every few days of koala and hear most nights from August to now
If they are not visible in the tree in our yard we often hear the grunting of a night of them in trees in the neighbours trees of 585 Redland Bay Road
